zh.title: 说明
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.8** 把工作台收成跨任务雷达：首页只看「需要你 / Peer 推进 / 未读」。Goal 完成即终态，不再多一道「结果待验收」。
没有待办时，主列拉成安静雷达面；工作区脉搏只汇总「需你 / 推进」。
隔离任务完成后会把工作树合回目标分支；未隔离的改动留在当前工作区，不再走验收闸门。
可从工作区行新建任务；源头分支支持搜索、分组和创建，不必先 checkout。
CLI 长工具循环不再被 64 轮上限打断，与 Desktop 一致。
文档站 Changelog 已同步本版说明。

zh.title: 新功能
items: **工作台雷达**：首页三桶为需要你、正在推进、未读；完成的 Goal 直接进历史。
**空态雷达面**：没有待办时主列撑满，提示 Peer 在推进、你可以离开。
**隔离完成即合回**：隔离工作树在 Goal 完成时合回目标分支；未隔离任务跳过交回闸门。
**工作区新建任务**：右键或悬停加号，从该工作区起一份绑定草稿。
**源头分支搜索 / 创建**：输入栏可搜本地与远程分支、新建本地分支；「在」是当前 HEAD，「从」是新任务分叉点。
**隔离标记**：隔离任务线用小树图标，而不是普通分支图标。

zh.title: 优化
items: 计划标题按意图命名，不再沿用第一句话；侧栏标题仅在未手改时同步。
侧栏工作台只显示「需要你」计数；运行指示钉在最右侧。
模式与权限入口排在分支 chrome 之前。
交回后输入栏回到源头胶囊；Worktree 开关表示下次偏好，不是当前隔离态。
任务运行中禁用隔离开关，避免中途改隔离。
附件改为媒体瓷片与文档卡；流式错误条可一键继续本轮。
文档站 Changelog 已生成本版条目。

zh.title: 修复
items: 流式/网络中断后可 Resume 同一轮，而不是只剩一条红错误。
CLI 交互与 Goal worker 去掉 Desktop 没有的轮次上限，长工具循环不再误报 turn-limit。
切换会话时其它工作区分组保持展开。
macOS 红绿灯在 40px 标题栏居中；应用图标铺满 squircle。
侧栏选中填充跟会话走，不再整组工作区发亮；嵌套工作区阴影不再被裁切。
上下文用量弹层阴影、主进程总览列表卡顿、托盘/CLI 主线程停顿已修。
发送后清掉共享的新任务草稿；证据不全时可强制归档，也可 Follow up 重开。

zh.title: 已知问题
items: 侧栏工作区右键菜单的后续交互仍在打磨，本版未纳入。
轻量问答仍不进工作台雷达。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: 本版 GitHub Release 附带 CLI 归档（与 Desktop 同 tag / 同版本）。
一等资产：`peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` / `peer-linux-x64.tar.gz`（内含 `peer` + `peer-credential-helper`，**必须同目录**）。
可通过 `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`（或 `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`）安装正式通道版本；`postinstall` 会拉取本版归档。
也可手动解压归档，将目录加入 `PATH`，执行 `peer --version` 校验后运行 `peer`。
CLI 与 Desktop 继续共享 `~/.peer-agent` 下的会话和设置。
长工具循环不再被 64 轮上限打断。

en.title: Notes
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.8** turns the workbench into a cross-task radar: home only shows Needs you / Peer advancing / Unread. A finished Goal is terminal — there is no extra “result ready” acceptance bucket.
When nothing needs you, the main column becomes a calm radar surface. Workspace pulse keeps need/run only.
Isolated tasks merge the worktree back to the target branch on completion; unisolated work stays in the current workspace and skips the handoff gate.
Start a new task from a workspace row. The source-branch picker can search, group, and create branches without checkout.
The CLI agent loop is unbounded like Desktop, so long tool runs no longer die on a 64-turn cap.
The docs-site Changelog includes this release.

en.title: Features
items: **Workbench radar**: home buckets are needs-you, advancing, and unread; completed Goals go to history.
**Empty radar surface**: with an empty inbox, the main column fills and says Peer is advancing, you can leave.
**Isolated complete-and-merge**: isolated worktrees merge on Goal completion; unisolated tasks skip the handoff gate.
**New task from a workspace**: right-click or hover the plus to start a draft bound to that project.
**Source-branch search / create**: search local and remote branches, or create a local branch; “on” is workspace HEAD, “from” is the new-task fork point.
**Isolation glyph**: isolated task lines use a small tree icon instead of the ordinary branch glyph.

en.title: Improvements
items: Plan titles follow intent, not the first utterance; the sidebar title syncs only if you have not renamed it.
The sidebar Workbench badge shows the needs-you count only; the running dot stays on the far right.
Mode and access sit before branch chrome.
After handoff, the composer returns to the source capsule; the Worktree toggle is the next-run preference, not current isolation.
Isolation cannot be toggled while a task is running.
Attachments render as media tiles and document cards; stream errors can resume the same turn.
The docs-site Changelog is generated for this version.

en.title: Fixes
items: Resume the current turn after a stream or network failure, instead of leaving only a red error strip.
Interactive CLI and Goal workers no longer inherit a Desktop-absent turn cap, so long tool loops do not fail with turn-limit.
Other workspace groups stay open when you switch sessions.
macOS traffic lights are centered in the 40px titlebar; the app icon fills the squircle.
Sidebar selection fill follows the conversation, not the whole workspace group; nested workspace shadows no longer clip.
Context-usage popover shadow, overview-list jank, and tray/CLI main-thread stalls are fixed.
Shared new-task drafts clear after send; incomplete evidence can be force-archived, or Follow up reopens the plan.

en.title: Known Issues
items: Follow-up interaction for the workspace row context menu is still in progress and is not in this release.
Lightweight Q&A still does not enter the workbench radar.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: This GitHub Release ships CLI archives under the same tag / version as Desktop.
First-class assets: `peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` / `peer-linux-x64.tar.gz` (contains `peer` + `peer-credential-helper`; they **must stay in the same directory**).
Install the stable channel with `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@latest` (or `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@latest`); `postinstall` downloads this release's archive.
Alternatively, unpack an archive manually, add its directory to `PATH`, run `peer --version`, and then run `peer`.
CLI and Desktop continue to share sessions and settings under `~/.peer-agent`.
Long tool loops are no longer cut off by a 64-turn cap.
